# `map_from_arrays`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Creates a map with a pair of the given key/value arrays. All elements
in keys should not be null

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
map_from_arrays(keys, values)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `map_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- map_from_arrays, example 1
> SELECT map_from_arrays(array(1.0, 3.0), array('2', '4'));
{1.0:"2",3.0:"4"}
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
